chapter_seo_title: Dao-Guai Yi-Xian Ch. 545: Li Huowang’s Dangerous Deal for the Taixu Sword
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang trades a Heart-Element corpse for the Taixu Sword’s use, hunts for an ally against Dice, and is summoned by the emperor. A chapter of cold deals and rising tension.
og_description: Li Huowang signs a contract for a dead man’s sword, while a eunuch waits with an imperial summons. In the Dao-Twisted World, every trade is a trap.
twitter_title: When a corpse buys you 20 years.
twitter_description: Li Huowang finalizes a deal for the Taixu Sword, then learns the emperor has been looking for him. Bureaucratic horror hits differently when the ink is still wet.

lore_anchors.definition: A government body that polices supernatural threats and rogue cultivators, operating with near-total autonomy and heavy bureaucracy.
The highest-ranking official of the Supervisory Heavenly Office, a position of immense political and supernatural power.
A xinsu’s dead body, treated as a valuable alchemical or ritual ingredient; Li Huowang trades one for sword rights.
A high-grade weapon made from a Heart-Pan, more powerful and rarer than a mere Heart-Element; its lease is the subject of this chapter’s deal.
A spiritually potent being refined into a weapon or artifact; far rarer than a Heart-Element, it makes the Taixu Sword priceless and dangerous.
A distorted cultivation concept derived from Buddhism, weaponizing a broad spectrum of human emotions as fuel for power.
A sect or intelligence network specializing in hidden knowledge, probably tied to astrology or the retrieval of secrets.
A secret technique or knowledge that Li Huowang considers using to locate Bai Lingmiao; its nature remains unexplored.
